headline: Agentic reliability, production profiling, and improved test observability reshape QA priorities

top_signal.title: Gremlin Foresight AI — agentic reliability checks that propose and re-run tests
top_signal.summary: Gremlin announced Foresight AI (general availability): supervised agents analyze service telemetry, recommend targeted fault-injection tests and remediations, then re-run the same tests to validate fixes and track reliability scores over time.
top_signal.why_it_matters: Brings an agentic closed-loop for reliability testing — automates discovery, test generation, and validation while preserving human approval and audit trails.

items.title: Cloudflare adds on-demand CPU and memory profiling (flamegraphs) for Workers
items.summary: Cloudflare Workers can now generate on-demand CPU and memory profiles with interactive flamegraphs in production, making it possible to pinpoint hotspots and memory leaks in serverless edge code without reproducing issues locally.
items.why_it_matters: Enables QA and performance engineers to collect actionable production profiles for flaky performance, regressions, and memory leaks, reducing time-to-root-cause for hard-to-reproduce failures.

items.title: Sentry JavaScript SDK v11 introduces tracing across Node, Cloudflare Workers, Bun and Deno
items.summary: Sentry v11 unifies tracing for all major JS runtimes via a code transformer and improved OpenTelemetry compatibility, adding span streaming and broader build/runtime instrumentation across server and edge platforms.
items.why_it_matters: Better end-to-end traces make test failure triage and flaky-test diagnosis easier across JS runtimes, improving signal quality for automated regression and performance tests.

items.title: JetBrains Marketplace exposes UI-freeze reports to plugin authors
items.summary: JetBrains Marketplace now shares captured UI-freeze reports and thread dumps with plugin authors when users report IDE freezes, supplying the runtime context needed to reproduce and triage unresponsive-plugin issues.
items.why_it_matters: Provides concrete telemetry and thread dumps for plugin tests, reducing blind-guess debugging and enabling reproducible test cases for UI-thread-related regressions.

items.title: CircleCI Machine Runner Orchestrator reaches GA for automated scaling of self-hosted runners
items.summary: CircleCI made Machine Runner Orchestrator generally available: a Kubernetes controller (KubeVirt) that automatically scales self-hosted machine runner VMs to match CI workload demand, with Helm charts and images public.
items.why_it_matters: Automated scaling reduces test queue times and resource waste for large test suites on self-hosted runners, but requires QA teams to validate orchestration, image consistency, and test isolation.

items.title: CodeQL 2.27.2 improves multi-language static analysis (C++, Go, Rust, JS)
items.summary: GitHub released CodeQL 2.27.2 with a new C++ regex parser and analysis improvements for C++, Go, Rust and JavaScript, plus updated security query coverage and CLI behavior updates relevant to code-scanning workflows.
items.why_it_matters: Improved language analyses reduce false negatives in static scans and change maintenance burden for QA/security pipelines; teams should validate new queries against infra and CI runners before roll-out.

learning.title: Android Bench 2.0 — long-horizon tasks, agentic evaluation, continuous scoring
learning.summary: Google’s Android Bench 2.0 adds long-horizon tasks, agent-based evaluation and continuous scoring to better measure multi-step, agentic developer workflows and model reliability on Android engineering tasks.
learning.why_it_matters: Its agentic evaluation and continuous scoring provide a practical template for QA teams building repeatable benchmarks for LLM-powered test agents and long-run correctness metrics.
